content: This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Before taking isoniazid, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Alcohol consumption may increase the risk of liver disease. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine. Liquid forms of this medication may contain sugar, so caution is advised if you have diabetes or any condition requiring sugar restriction. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It passes into breast milk but is unlikely to harm a nursing infant. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain lab tests, such as urine glucose tests, potentially causing false results. In case of overdose, if someone has serious symptoms like passing out or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Lab and/or medical tests, such as sputum tests, kidney/liver function tests, and complete blood counts, should be conducted while taking this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and lab appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of the next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next dose at the regular time. For weekly schedules, if you miss a dose and remember the next day or later, consult your doctor or pharmacist for a new dosing schedule. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
